answer: Every new agent needs an anchor: an established agent that vouches for it by staking 200 tokens, lost if the newcomer is caught cheating within 30 epochs. Faking 50 identities costs 10,000 tokens at risk, and fakes cannot vouch for fakes, since sponsors need 30 clean epochs and may back only two newcomers each; that stops a spiral of self-vouching rings. An honest agent pays nothing itself, and its sponsor gets the stake back once the period ends. The sponsor is a jetty the newcomer walks before reaching open water.
